name: intraday-equities-hstar-cv
notes: SUPERSEDED by run-hstar-cv-series.json. Clock-mean pooling; aborted after two folds. Do not run. Occupied dirs are the 2019-01-07 and 2019-03-11 clock-mean folds.

universe.notes: lead_start is the training label (5 RTH minutes). scan.estimator is the frozen LightGBM. This document does not restate them.

alpaca.notes: Historical SIP tape. root is the invoking cwd; run from the child root.

session.notes: Research uses regular-session rows; the store still keeps every vendor minute.

features.notes: Full session depth for the H pass. L and keep are pass 2.

tradable.notes: Score tradable names only. SPY already entered residuals.

scan.notes: One LightGBM ŷ at lead_start. Walk y(h) with Clark–West vs the train mean. A label may not land after this fold's val_end.

walkforward.notes: 3y slide. Fold 40 val is 2025-09-29 → 2025-11-30. embargo_days is lead_stop (3 sessions), not H-length. GO iff mean(go) ≥ 0.5; h* is the median of folds with go=1, read from fold metrics after the summary.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Summary is {name}-walkforward-{asof}-{hash8}.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd.

tracking.notes: Excluded from identity — where metrics land is not what the run computes.
